summary: dxc silently compiles a statically out-of-bounds constant array index (struct-member array of size 1, indexed then swizzled) with no warning/error on every probeable release and on main; DXC already has a related Sema check (err_hlsl_array_element_index_out_of_bounds) but two of its own exemptions (swizzle-wrapped subscripts, and size-1 struct-member arrays for the C89 flexible-array idiom) both apply to this exact shape.
title: DXC should warn on statically checkable out-of-bounds
